1.1 0,33 = 33/100

1.2 3/15 = 1/5

1.3 22/7 = 3,14

1.4 0,123412341234 = 
let 0.1234.. = x
x * 100000 =100000x
=100000x - x = 1234,1234... - 0,1234...
=9999x = 1234
x = 1234/9999

1.5 0,828282828282 = 
let 0,828282828282 = x
x * 100 = 100x
100x - x = 82,8282... - 0,8282..
=99x = 82
x = 82/99
